key_findings: Homozygous TRPV1 N331K renders the channel nonfunctional; carriers are capsaicin-insensitive with elevated heat- and cold-pain thresholds and no capsaicin neurogenic inflammation.
Loss of TRPV1 function leaves histamine itch intact and increases sensitivity to the TRPA1 activator AITC.
